descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
SKY BOXING is a penthouse at three hundred metres, and everything in it is yours to use.

THE GLASS GYM
Walk through the sliding doors and the balcony closes in around you - a glass box cantilevered off the side of the tower, with a freestanding heavy bag in the middle of it. The gloves go on by themselves the moment you are outside. Punch the green GO button on the wall and a round starts: sixty, ninety, a hundred and twenty or a hundred and eighty seconds. The board behind the bag counts your punches, reads the speed of the last one in miles per hour, and remembers the best round you have ever thrown.

THE COURT
Back inside, the lounge is a full practice court. Take one of the two rackets off the wall and the ball machine on the far baseline starts feeding. Speed, feed rate and how many balls are live are all on the panel beside the rackets, and there is bullet time on the controller when you want to watch one arrive.

FIVE SKIES
The pedestal by the glass changes the world outside: sunset, daylight, dawn, emerald and neon dusk. Traffic runs past the window at every hour - race pods, lux pods, drone swarms and a ninety-six metre sky liner.

COMFORT
Smooth walking with forty-five degree snap turn. No teleport, no forced movement, no enemies, and no way to fail. Music plays throughout and can be changed or switched off from the menu.
